tests.case: uses the shared Twitch setup destination and handles %s

IgdbSettingsTests.Setup_page_uses_the_sh.reason: Both desktop and fullscreen use the named external-link bridge for the exact shared Twitch setup destination.

tests.case: acknowledges an accepted save with normalized identity clear secret and queued metadata refresh
Accepted_save_protects_the_secret_clears_every_token_and_notifies_the_existing_refresh_source

IgdbSettingsTests.Save_protects_secret_c.reason: Real HTTP and SQLite verify protection, token invalidation, normalized values and the existing credential reader; both forms clear the secret and report queued metadata refresh.

tests.case: rejects missing fields locally without writing: %j
Missing_fields_do_not_write_or_notify

IgdbSettingsTests.Missing_field_does_not.reason: Both forms reject either missing field and focus it without a write; the production endpoint independently refuses incomplete credentials without notifications.

tests.case: preserves the saved pair and masked draft when protection is refused
Protection_refusal_preserves_the_previous_identity_and_cached_tokens

IgdbSettingsTests.Protection_refusal_pre.reason: The production backend retains the previous identity and cached tokens; both forms explain the storage refusal while retaining the masked draft.

tests.case: removes accepted credentials immediately and explains remaining configuration: %s
Removal_clears_saved_legacy_and_token_rows_and_reports_configuration_fallback

IgdbSettingsTests.Remove_clears_saved_pa.reason: Both configuration states are covered through real HTTP and both forms; removal clears all saved/legacy/token rows and fields, and explains immediate effect and fallback.

tests.case: loads the credential state %j without copying or revealing a secret
Configuration_credentials_are_reported_without_copying_their_identity_or_secret_to_the_frontend

IgdbSettingsTests.Configuration_load_doe.reason: Production redacted snapshots report external configuration without copying credentials. Both presentation paths start with an empty secret and preserve the snapshot identity.

tests.case: loads the credential state %j without copying or revealing a secret
Reading_legacy_credentials_uses_the_runtime_migration_without_exposing_the_secret

IgdbSettingsTests.Load_migrates_legacy_c.reason: The real GET invokes the existing legacy migration, protects and empties the old plaintext row, and returns only the readable state and client ID.

tests.case: explains configuration fallback beside an unreadable saved pair
An_unreadable_protected_value_remains_saved_but_is_never_returned

IgdbSettingsTests.Unreadable_protected_s.reason: An unreadable protected value remains saved in the production snapshot but never reaches the renderer; both forms prompt for replacement and explain any configured fallback.

tests.case: keeps failed credential mutation drafts and hides exception details, remove %s
Failed_mutations_roll_back_every_row_and_return_no_exception_details

IgdbSettingsTests.Failed_mutations_roll_.reason: Both failed save and removal roll back every existing SQLite row under a controlled mid-transaction failure. The HTTP response and both forms omit exception details, retain drafts and permit retry.

tests.case: makes failed reads actionable without exposing service exception details
A_failed_read_is_sanitized_and_can_be_retried

IgdbSettingsTests.Read_failure_is_action.reason: A controlled storage read failure returns a sanitized HTTP error. Both presentation paths show an actionable retry that restores the saved state.

tests.case: uses the shared Twitch setup destination and handles %s

IgdbSettingsTests.Setup_opens_Twitch_app.reason: Both forms cover successful dispatch, refusal and exceptions at the shared external-link bridge, with the original manual destination hint and no exception details.
